description: Compute a trade's position size from account size, risk percent per trade, entry price, and stop-loss price: the dollar risk divided by the per-unit stop distance, floored to a whole share/unit count. Also infers the trade direction (long/short) and, given an optional target price, the risk/reward ratio and whether the target sits on the correct side of entry.

riskPercent.description: Percent of the account willing to risk on this trade (0-100)

stopLossPrice.description: The stop-loss price; must differ from entryPrice

targetPrice.description: Optional take-profit price, used to compute the risk/reward ratio

name: calculate_position_size
